questions.explain: The last plate placed on the pile is the first one taken.

questions.prompt: Start empty. push 4, push 8, pop, push 6, peek. What does peek return?
questions.explain: After pop removes 8, the stack is [4]. Pushing 6 makes 6 the top.

questions.prompt: A stack holds one million items. How long does pop take?
questions.explain: Pop only touches the top item, so the size of the stack does not matter.

questions.prompt: Which of these behaves like a stack?
questions.explain: Undo reverses your most recent action first. Lines and counters are queues.
